defects.title: Race condition causes appointment double-booking during peak hours
defects.description: When two hospital receptionists simultaneously book the same doctor slot, both bookings succeed due to lack of distributed optimistic locking.

defects.title: Patient medical record (EHR) corruption on concurrent lab upload
defects.description: Concurrent multipart laboratory PDF uploads intermittently overwrite previous doctor diagnostic notes in the patient history collection.

defects.title: Doctor availability slot calculation timezone mismatch
defects.description: Branch doctors in different timezones display 1-hour slot shift in admin calendar.

defects.title: Hospital invoice printable PDF column misalignment
defects.description: Minor overflow of tax itemization text on 80mm receipt printers.

items.item: Zero double-booking occurrences under 100 concurrent requests
SMS and email notifications dispatched within 5 seconds
Patient appointment history pagination loads in < 500ms
Role-based access check on cancellation endpoint
items.remarks: Tested with PM, Doctor, Patient tokens

qualityInspections.notes: Blocked by open Critical defect DEF-001. Requires database transaction lock before quality sign-off.

risks.description: Appointment concurrency race condition causes patient conflict in hospital OPD
risks.preventiveAction: Implement Redis distributed lock and MongoDB optimistic concurrency versioning (__v).
risks.correctiveAction: Auto-rollback overlapping transaction and offer alternate immediate slot with priority badge.

risks.description: Patient medical record corruption during high-volume lab result imports
risks.preventiveAction: Enforce atomic updates using $push with idempotency keys on all lab upload streams.
risks.correctiveAction: Trigger automated data integrity checksum and restore prior patient snapshot from point-in-time backup.

risks.description: Schedule slippage in Appointment module cascades to Doctor Shifts and Billing
risks.preventiveAction: Fast-track non-critical frontend tasks and parallelize independent billing schema design.
risks.correctiveAction: Authorize overtime for backend engineers and negotiate CR-001 schedule buffer extension.

risks.description: Cost overrun due to unexpected cloud infrastructure scaling and SDK licenses
risks.preventiveAction: Establish automated cloud spending alarms and reserve instances for 12 months.
risks.correctiveAction: Reallocate management reserve from contingency budget and re-negotiate vendor tier.

risks.description: Doctor resistance to digital tele-consultation and shift reassignments
risks.preventiveAction: Conduct hands-on interactive training workshops for hospital department heads.
risks.correctiveAction: Provide designated hospital tech liaison in OPD to assist doctors during first 2 weeks.

risks.description: Browser latency issues with high-resolution digital X-ray dental imaging
risks.preventiveAction: Use lightweight HTML5 Canvas DICOM image rendering engine with client-side compression.
risks.correctiveAction: Provide fallback server-side PNG rendering for low-spec clinic reception computers.
